descriptionHtml:
MSI Cyborg 15 A13UC-2078XEG Gaming Laptop - Intel Core i7-13620H - RTX 3050 4GB - Cyberpunk Translucent Edition

Embrace the ultimate cyberpunk aesthetic and futuristic gaming power with the MSI Cyborg 15 A13UC-2078XEG, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Featuring a groundbreaking translucent chassis design, this laptop lets you see its internal mechanics while delivering top-tier performance. Driven by the architectural efficiency of the Intel Core i7-13620H processor and heavily accelerated by the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 dedicated graphics engine, it ensures high frame rates across modern competitive titles. Enjoy crisp and smooth gameplay on the 15.6-inch FHD display with a fast 144Hz refresh rate. Equipped with an illuminated blue gaming keyboard and a specialized cooling layout, this sleek and lightweight powerhouse is backed by a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
